# Kawaki Studios
> Custom Web Development, High-Performance Shopify Stores, and Bespoke Digital Experiences.

Kawaki Studios (https://www.kawaki.co.in) is a premier digital engineering and web design studio founded by Kunal Sharma. We build custom websites, high-velocity Shopify Plus stores, and interactive digital flagships with sub-second performance for ambitious brands globally.

## Core Services & Architecture
- [Custom Web Design & Development](https://www.kawaki.co.in/services): Full-stack custom web applications, Next.js architecture, bespoke content platforms, and sub-second performance.
- [Shopify Store & Headless Commerce](https://www.kawaki.co.in/services): Shopify Plus storefronts, Hydrogen architecture, custom checkout & cart mutations, and conversion optimization.
- [Web Performance & Core Web Vitals](https://www.kawaki.co.in/services): Sub-second loading (<200ms TTFB), 95+ PageSpeed scores, and edge CDN distribution.
